reviews.summary: All round-1 fixes made correctly. It beats the top results because they are Q&A threads arguing about whether the word is correct, while this page settles the word in two sentences, then gives a month-by-month plan with times and lines to send.

Every product claim matches the manifests and schemas, the 29th–31st rule matches the code, the word-origin and gift-list facts are right in both languages, and the post answers both 'what is it' and 'what do we do each month' with specific plans and lines to send.

Every People-also-ask question is answered; the first page is Q&A threads, Reddit opinions and an etymology column, and this post settles the word and the 'is it worth it' question in two paragraphs, then gives a 12-month table with times, a first-month section, lines to borrow and when to stop.
